description: Encrypted snapshot of a group's state for joiners, written by the group creator. The plaintext is an is.neuros.atsignal.defs#groupSnapshot encrypted under a group-state key that only members receive.

main.description: Encrypted snapshot of a group's state for joiners, written by the group creator. The record key is a random 22-character group id with no meaning. The plaintext is an is.neuros.atsignal.defs#groupSnapshot encrypted under a group-state key that only members receive.

epoch.description: Group epoch of this snapshot. Increments with every accepted groupChange.

stateCiphertext.description: An is.neuros.atsignal.defs#groupSnapshot, DAG-CBOR encoded and encrypted under the group-state key.
